description: CLI interface for Scrunch AI API

agent-traffic.usage_instructions: View agent traffic data. Commands: get.

get.help: Get agent traffic data for a brand's site. Both brand_id and site_id are required positional arguments. start_date and end_date are required options.
get.usage_instructions: Get agent traffic. Required arguments: brand_id, site_id. Notable options: --start-date, --end-date, --fields, --time-bucket, --table/-t, --limit, --offset.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated fields to include in output

auth.usage_instructions: Manage authentication. Commands: login, status, test, logout, refresh.

login.help: Configure authentication credentials. Prompts for required credentials based on the tool's authentication type. For OAuth authorization code flows, opens a browser for user consent.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to save credentials to

options.name: --force
options.help: Clear existing ephemeral auth state and re-authenticate

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to clear credentials from

profiles.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch auth profiles --help` for exact arguments and options.

create.help: Create a new profile from .env.example template.
create.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch auth profiles create --help` for exact arguments and options.

delete.help: Delete a profile and its data.
delete.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch auth profiles delete --help` for exact arguments and options.

get.help: Get details for a specific profile.
get.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch auth profiles get --help` for exact arguments and options.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to get details for

list.help: List all profiles and show their auth types and active state.
list.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch auth profiles list --help` for exact arguments and options.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of profiles to return

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated list of fields to include

remove.help: Delete a profile and its data.

rename.help: Rename a profile, re-keying its secrets to the new profile name.

arguments.name: new
arguments.help: New profile name (must not already exist)

options.name: --keep-old
options.help: Build and activate the new profile but leave the old profile dir and old secrets intact

select.help: Activate a profile within its auth type.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Profile name to activate within its auth type

status.help: Check authentication status across profiles. Performs a live round-trip for every configured credential type so the report reflects ground truth — not on-disk belief. Saved credentials whose live verification fails are reported as ``authenticated: false`` with the failure reason in ``api_test``.

options.name: --profile
options.help: Profile name to check (defaults to all profiles)

test.help: Test authentication by verifying credentials work across profiles.

brands.usage_instructions: Manage brands. Commands: list, get, create, update, delete.

create.usage_instructions: Create a new brand. Notable options: --name, --website, --description.

delete.usage_instructions: Archive a brand. Required arguments: brand_id.

get.help: Get details for a specific brand.
get.usage_instructions: Get brand details. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

update.usage_instructions: Update a brand. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --name, --website, --description.

cache.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch cache --help` for exact arguments and options.

clear.help: Remove all cached responses. Deletes every file in the cache directory ({storage_dir}/cache/) and reports how many files and bytes were freed.
clear.usage_instructions: Run `scrunch cache clear --help` for exact arguments and options.

competitors.usage_instructions: Manage brand competitors. Commands: list, get, create, update, delete.

create.help: Create a new competitor for a brand.
create.usage_instructions: Create a competitor. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --name.

delete.usage_instructions: Archive a competitor. Required arguments: brand_id, competitor_id.

get.help: Get details for a specific competitor.
get.usage_instructions: Get competitor details. Required arguments: brand_id, competitor_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.usage_instructions: List competitors for a brand. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --properties/-p.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

update.usage_instructions: Update a competitor. Required arguments: brand_id, competitor_id. Notable options: --name.

page-audits.usage_instructions: Manage page audits. Commands: list, get, create.

create.help: Create a new page audit for a brand.

get.help: Get details for a specific page audit.
get.usage_instructions: Get audit details. Required arguments: brand_id, audit_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.help: List page audits for a brand.
list.usage_instructions: List page audits. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --status, --url, --table/-t, --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --properties/-p.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

personas.usage_instructions: Manage brand personas. Commands: list, get, create, update, delete.

create.help: Create a new persona for a brand.
create.usage_instructions: Create a persona. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --name, --description.

delete.usage_instructions: Archive a persona. Required arguments: brand_id, persona_id.

get.help: Get details for a specific persona.
get.usage_instructions: Get persona details. Required arguments: brand_id, persona_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.usage_instructions: List personas for a brand. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --properties/-p.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

update.usage_instructions: Update a persona. Required arguments: brand_id, persona_id. Notable options: --name, --description.

prompts.usage_instructions: Manage brand prompts. Commands: list, get, create, delete.

create.help: Create a new prompt for a brand.
examples: scrunch prompts create 123 --text "What is the best AI tool?" --stage Awareness
scrunch prompts create 123 --text "Compare AI tools" --stage Comparison --platforms "chatgpt,claude"
create.usage_instructions: Create a prompt. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --text, --stage, --platforms.

options.name: --stage
options.help: Prompt stage (Advice, Awareness, Evaluation, Comparison, Other)

delete.usage_instructions: Archive a prompt. Required arguments: brand_id, prompt_id.

get.help: Get details for a specific prompt.
get.usage_instructions: Get prompt details. Required arguments: brand_id, prompt_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --properties/-p.

list.usage_instructions: List prompts for a brand. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --table/-t, --limit/-l, --filter/-f, --properties/-p.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

metrics.help: Query aggregated metrics for a brand. Dimensions: date, date_week, date_month, date_quarter, date_year, prompt_id, prompt, persona_id, persona_name, ai_platform, ai_platform_search_enabled, tag, source_url, source_type, competitor_id, competitor_name, branded, stage, prompt_topic, country Metrics: responses, brand_presence_percentage, brand_position_score, brand_sentiment_score, competitor_presence_percentage, competitor_position_score, competitor_sentiment_score
metrics.usage_instructions: Query metrics for a brand. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --fields, --start-date, --end-date, --limit, --offset, --table/-t.

options.name: --fields
options.help: Comma-separated dimension/metric fields to include in query

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return (max 90000)

options.name: --properties
options.help: Comma-separated fields to include in output

list.help: List AI responses for a brand.
list.usage_instructions: List AI responses. Required arguments: brand_id. Notable options: --platform, --prompt-id, --persona-id, --stage, --start-date, --end-date, --limit, --table/-t.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of items to return

usage_instructions: Use for cLI interface for Scrunch AI API - brand visibility, AI search analytics, competitors, personas, prompts, and agent traffic. Commands follow `scrunch <group> <action>` patterns. Consult this file before running commands so flags and positional arguments match the CLI.
